assumptions: linear extrapolation of the observed 2.75-hour rate
FULL uses the docks<=4 floor, not docks==0
nearest-source greedy matching, not an optimal transport solve
straight-line distance; no van capacity, traffic or shift constraints
target: 3 bikes for an empty station, 2 for a low station

actions.action: Replace the docks == 0 definition of FULL with docks <= 4 AND occupancy >= 0.75.
actions.expected_impact: removes a full-station alert that can never fire
actions.limits: occupancy still relies on a soft capacity field

actions.action: Dispatch technicians to the 4 stations that are not renting in every snapshot.
actions.where: King Alfred (6506), Portslade Station - North (7195), The Droveway - Waitrose (7197), London Rd / Ann Street (9648)
actions.falsifier: the station starts renting before the visit
actions.limits: no outage duration or lost-trip estimate yet

actions.action: Move 20 bikes in 7 moves from 7 surplus stations to 7 deficit stations.
actions.where: Medina Terrace -> King Alfred, Sussex County Cricket Ground -> Brunswick Place, Brighton Station - South -> Seven Dials / Vernon Terrace
actions.expected_impact: at least one bike restored to 7 stations; 3.26 km
actions.falsifier: those stations still report EMPTY two hours after the move
actions.limits: greedy nearest-source plan; no van capacity or traffic model

actions.action: Show 'likely to be empty or full' flags for the 10 highest-risk stations, with a confidence label.

actions.limits: risk is extrapolated from 2.75 hours; no forecast is claimed
